Rent sysvar init, write, read, and rent-exempt minimum balance functions.

# Purpose
This header file declares the interface for the `rent` sysvar in the runtime. It includes functions to initialize the cached rent account in the database, write the current rent value back to `funk`, and read the rent value from `funk` when the account exists and has lamports. It also declares [`fd_rent_exempt_minimum_balance`](<#fd_rent_exempt_minimum_balance>), which computes the minimum balance needed for an account to stay rent exempt for a given data length. The file only provides function prototypes and related type declarations, and it does not define the function bodies.

- `fd_sysvar_rent_init`
- `fd_sysvar_rent_write`
- `fd_rent_exempt_minimum_balance`
- `fd_sysvar_rent_read`
